raw_segments.text: The police station was about a quarter of a mile off.
It had lately been moved to new rooms on the fourth floor of a new house.
He had been once for a moment in the old office but long ago.
Turning in at the gateway, he saw on the right a flight of stairs which a peasant
was mounting with a book in his hand.
So then, the office is here.
And he began ascending the stairs on the chance.
He did not want to ask questions of anyone.
